title: Physical Endometrial Manipulation and Its Effect on ICSI
brief_summary: Unexplained infertility is clinically diagnosed when there are no apparent or clear factors causing infertility on regular infertility assessment tools . Failure of implantation is a possible factor causing unexplained infertility . Implantation is the main rate limiting step in IVF outcome. Implantation is described at cellular and molecular level by adhesion or fixation of good quality embryo to receptive endometrium within a critical period of time which is called the window of implantation .
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infertile female age 20-35 years
* Previous Failed one ICSI trial
* normal basal hormonal profile \[FSH, LH\] 3-10 mIU/ml and 1.8-8.5 mIU/ml respectively, --normal endometrial cavity
* patent tubes
* normal Husband semen analysis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Ovarian factor of infertility
* Tubal factor of infertility
* Endometrial factor of infertility
* Male factor of infertility
